payload.label: A
payload.candidate_selection: Maximum mean inner fold ROC-AUC; exact ties use original grid order.
payload.threshold_selection: Selected candidate inner OOF only, using epa_harness.threshold.
payload.preprocessing: Constant-zero imputation and model-specific scaling fit on each training split; weights recomputed per fit.
payload.selection_rule: Mean overall seedwise MCC descending, then ROC-AUC descending, then sensitivity-specificity gap ascending; exact ties use lr/rf/xgb and wmean/max order.
payload.scope: Exploratory model/representation comparison, not unbiased performance of winner-selection. Repeated seeds are not independent cohorts. No final refit is performed here.
